title: Finite type relative Proj is proper
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a quasi-coherent finite-type O_S-module. The structural morphism of the canonical relative Proj of Sym(E) [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra] is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism].

proof.text: Choose the affine finite-generator presentations of E. Each local relative Proj embeds as a closed subscheme of finite projective space, hence is H-projective and proper. The local relative-Proj maps identify with restrictions of the global relative Proj along the affine cover, and target-locality of properness concludes.
